description: Hooks of this eca: aos functions run when an event happens. eca has before_queue, after_queue, brain_failed (CliFailed / ReplyMissing) and tool_added and on_clock in aos-eca-turn, after_start / after_stop from loop.json, and before_tool / after_tool only for aos tools called through aos-mcp; the CLI's own tools and what a person types on the screen are not seen. The stack copy of this file overrides it by name, null turns one off. The timer hook is a place to hang something every 5 minutes (on_clock, every_ms 300000, AOS_CLOCK); its handler does nothing. The mail_notify hook looks at your mailbox every 10 seconds (on_clock, every_ms 10000) and, only when new letters came, puts one message "[aos] new_mail: N new letters from A, B. ..." in your queue; turn it off or change the interval in your stack copy (self_hook rm / add with replace).
